PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Tooltip: Test only: plays voice chat audio from the local character and reports where it is heard
PluginData.Description: Test only, for tests/voice-chat-position/rig.py of the Bugfixes plugin. A line "go" written to voice-probe.txt in the game's user data folder makes the probe play voice chat audio from the local character the way the game plays another player's voice, move the character, seat it, and write the distance the audio engine uses next to the real one into voice-probe-done.txt.
